name: dotclaude
description: Claude Code skills, agents, commands, and hooks from the dotclaude registry, bundled as installable plugins.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills, review agents, and a /feature pipeline: orientation, planning, test-driven development, systematic debugging, refactoring, error handling, observability, containers, CI pipelines, dependency upgrades, migration planning, incident postmortems, code review, completion verification, and performance work.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documentation that stays true to the code: architecture decision records with an /adr command, READMEs verified against the repository, developer guides in the four documentation types, and OpenAPI specifications kept in sync in CI.

plugins.name: pr-toolkit
plugins.description: Pull-request review as a set of specialists: a read-only code explorer, a behaviour-preserving simplifier, hunters for silent failures and test gaps, a type-design reviewer, and a /review-pr command that runs them in parallel and merges one ranked review.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security review toolkit: OWASP-aligned code review, dependency and secret auditing skills, a security-auditor agent, and a full-codebase /security-audit command.

plugins.name: security-hooks
plugins.description: Deterministic guardrails, active immediately after install: a compound-command deny list, sensitive-file protection, and prompt-injection screening.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Version-control skills for the whole branch lifecycle: committing, worktrees, merge conflicts, undo/recovery, PR descriptions, changelogs, releases, and branch cleanup.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Session and personal productivity: collaborative brainstorming, plan stress-testing, session handoffs, meeting notes, a decision log, learning plans, a /prime command that loads project context, and a /weekly-review that assembles the week from evidence.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Testing toolkit: browser-based end-to-end verification with Playwright and a /write-tests command that generates a suite matching project conventions.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Investigation toolkit: a deep-research subagent for multi-source work with citations, plus name-clearing skills for software projects (registries, app stores) and for businesses (social handles, storefronts, company registers).

plugins.name: thesis
plugins.description: The research lifecycle for a master's thesis or paper: research question and proposal, multi-source literature search, structured paper notes, a verified BibTeX bibliography, citation verification with a hook that catches invented keys as they are written, argument-first literature synthesis, research design and design science, statistics planning and reporting, PRISMA systematic reviews, citation-graph expansion, reproducible experiments and benchmark reporting, section-by-section academic writing, LaTeX and Word toolchains, publication figures, an examiner-style reviewer and a paper critic, proofreading, supervisor updates, a research log, and progress tracking.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Prose for a human reader: strip machine-writing tells from any text, draft emails that get answered, and outline talks and defences slide by slide.

plugins.name: workflow-hooks
plugins.description: Session workflow guardrails, active on install: a session-start situation report, a stop gate that runs the tests before Claude finishes, type errors fed back after each edit, git footgun protection, a branch-first nudge, and a subagent audit log.

plugins.name: format-on-edit
plugins.description: Automation hook that runs the project's own formatter (Biome, Prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, or ruff) on every file Claude edits, so changes land already formatted.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for Claude Code: surfaces permission requests and attention prompts as native macOS/Linux notifications so long sessions can run in the background.

plugins.name: precompact-saver
plugins.description: Context-preservation hook that snapshots the full session transcript before every compaction, keeping the newest ten snapshots per project.

plugins.name: tool-call-logger
plugins.description: Observability hook that appends one sanitized JSON line per tool call to a local log, with secret redaction and payload truncation.
